vetSays.line: 🛡️ Ernesto, Samuel, Easton, Jayden and Rudra met them at the door — 5 put down. Ernesto, Samuel, Easton, Jayden, Rudra are hurt.
🛡️ Samuel, Jayden and Rudra met them at the door — 3 put down. Samuel, Jayden, Rudra are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Meera just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jayden, Rudra, Carlos, Miguel and Meera met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Jayden, Rudra, Carlos, Miguel, Meera are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carlos just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rudra just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jayden, Rudra, Miguel and Meera met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Rudra, Miguel, Meera are hurt.
🛡️ Jose and Olga met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Jose, Olga are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jose just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Miguel presses something into your hand. "Ground Elder — for what you did. Look for the leaves. You'll know it."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Rudra was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
Ruth showed Jose the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Olga: "Walked past a good stand of ground elder. Worth remembering where."
